Sam (CSM): Heads-up: VegaCorp dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:30 PT. Target steady 600 RPS, brief spikes to 2k for ~30s. Need final quota check, autoscale policy, and a short SRE enablement doc. Renewal in 10 months; flagged for health review.

Ravi (Infra Eng): Copy. Contract shows 10 reserved GPUs, burst up to +25% if spare. Share token distribution so I can size max_seq and slots.

Jo (SRE): We should gate traffic for first 12h and enable soft-throttle at 80% GPU mem. Also add alert if tail latency >600ms for 3 consecutive 1m intervals.

Sam (CSM): Quick sample: p50=55 tokens, p95=200, avg request ~290 tokens. Sending CSV to the thread.

Ravi (Infra Eng): With p95 200, set slot max_seq=512, min_slots=3, scale_step=2, cooldown=90s. Pre-warm KV cache - recommend priming script for 20m prior.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Load plan: smoke 10m @100 RPS, soak 2h @600 RPS, spike test: 20s ramp -> 2k, hold 30s, decay 40s. Use loadgen v1 with token traces. I'll run it during the window.

Jo (SRE): I'll create the incident runbook snippet and slot-lock for 12h post-cutover. Also adding contact matrix to the calendar invite.

Sam (CSM): Action items: @Ravi apply autoscale + priming (tonight EOD), @Jo set throttle + slot lock (AM), @Priya run load scripts. ops-bot please set reminder for 09:15 PT.
